result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly around clipped carousel elements and low contrast in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses white text on a very light mint-green background, making the headline and promo-code text difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text color or increase the banner background contrast so the message remains clearly legible.

issues.description: A partially visible empty category pill appears on the far right after “Healthy,” which looks like a broken or unlabeled filter chip.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible carousel items show enough label text, add right padding/fade treatment, or avoid showing an empty-looking clipped chip.

issues.description: The restaurant cards in the horizontal “Fastest near you” row are clipped at the right edge, including partial image and text for the next item. This may be intentional, but it looks abrupt without a scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade, more spacing, or ensure the next card is clipped in a way that clearly indicates horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The bottom navigation overlaps the lower content area, cutting off the next restaurant card image at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
